AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > extract.txt 2>&1
import gzip, io, json, tarfile, urllib.request
import boto3
REPO = "eyecloud-fargate-runner"
TAG = "mott-lane-35"
ecr = boto3.client("ecr", region_name="us-east-1")
resp = ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": TAG}])
images = resp.get("images") or []
assert images, "batch_get_image returned no image for %s" % TAG
manifest = json.loads(images[0]["imageManifest"])
if "manifests" in manifest:
    entry = next(m for m in manifest["manifests"] if m.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
    resp2 = ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": entry["digest"]}])
    manifest = json.loads(resp2["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
layers = manifest["layers"]
print("LAYERS=%d" % len(layers))
found = {}
for idx, layer in enumerate(layers):
    url = ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=layer["digest"])["downloadUrl"]
    blob = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=300).read()
    try:
        tf = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(blob)))
    except OSError:
        tf = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(blob))
    for m in tf.getmembers():
        base = m.name.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        if base in ("bland_gateway.py", "capability_registry.py") and m.isfile():
            found[base] = (idx, m.name, tf.extractfile(m).read())
            print("HIT layer=%d path=%s file=%s bytes=%d" % (idx, m.name, base, found[base][2] and len(found[base][2])))
assert "bland_gateway.py" in found, "bland_gateway.py not found in any layer"
for base, (idx, path, data) in found.items():
    out = "bland_gateway_prod.py" if base == "bland_gateway.py" else "capability_registry_prod.py"
    open(out, "wb").write(data)
    print("WROTE %s from layer=%d PATH_IN_IMAGE=/%s" % (out, idx, path))
import hashlib
body = open("bland_gateway_prod.py", "rb").read()
print("LINES=%d" % (body.count(b"\n")))
print("SHA=%s" % hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()[:16])
print("EXTRACT_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; diff -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-raw-text/work2/raw-text-authority-v2/bland_gateway_live.py bland_gateway_prod.py > prod_vs_snapshot.diff 2>/dev/null; echo "DIFF_VS_SNAPSHOT_LINES=$(wc -l < prod_vs_snapshot.diff)" >> extract.txt; tail -10 extract.txt; exit $rc
